site.name: Ollivanders Wand Atelier
site.heroTitle: Handcrafted wands that choose their wizard
site.heroText: Every wand is shaped from rare woods and bound to a single magical core. Discover the models of our collection.
site.aboutText: For over two thousand years our family has studied the delicate magic of wandlore. Each model in our collection is carved by hand, balanced by feel, and paired with a core of unicorn hair, phoenix feather or dragon heartstring. Visit our shop for polishing kits, holsters and more.
site.footer: © Ollivanders Wand Atelier · Diagon Alley, London

wands.name: The Elder Wand
wands.description: The most powerful wand ever made. Pale, knotted and unforgiving, it is said to be unbeatable in the hands of its master.

wands.name: Holly & Phoenix
wands.description: Supple and spirited. A wand of protection, rarely drawn to those who are not brave of heart.

wands.name: Vine & Dragon
wands.description: Chosen by those with hidden depths and a greater purpose. Powerful and quick to respond.

wands.name: Yew & Phoenix
wands.description: A rare and formidable wand, for the bold who walk in the shadow of great destiny.

wands.name: Willow & Unicorn
wands.description: Slender and graceful, the willow wand heals — and is drawn to those with untapped potential.

wands.name: Cherry & Dragon
wands.description: Dark red and deeply lustrous. An uncommon wand that favours the fiercely loyal.

shop.name: Wand Care Kit
shop.description: Beeswax polish, soft cloth and a pocket-size wand brush.

shop.name: Leather Wand Holster
shop.description: Hand-stitched leather holster that fits any wand up to 15 inches.

shop.name: Ollivanders Wand Box
shop.description: Gift box lined with velvet, sealed with a gold wax crest.

shop.name: Brass Wand Stand
shop.description: Display your wand in style with this engraved brass stand.

shop.name: Enchanted Ink Set
shop.description: Quill, three inks and a parchment pad for correspondence.

shop.name: Traveller's Cloak
shop.description: Heavy wool cloak with silver clasp, perfect for the cold castle halls.

announcement.title: The Winter Wand Fair Is Coming
announcement.content:
Our newest collection of handcrafted wands arrives this season.

Visit the shop for limited editions, and ask us about a custom commission.

event.title: Meet the Wandmaker at Diagon Alley Market
event.content: Live wand fittings, demonstrations and the chance to find the wand that chooses you.
